priority_1.title: Upgrade Pose Model (yolov8n-pose -> yolov8m-pose) and Link Pose to MOT Tracks
priority_1.rationale: Pose infrastructure already exists and runs on every frame. Nano model quality is too low. Floating track_id=-1 poses cannot be attributed to persons. Drop-in upgrade with no training requirement.

priority_2.title: Appearance-Augmented Tracker (ByteTrack + OSNet ReID)
priority_2.rationale: 954 total tracks for 595s video indicates severe fragmentation. Track breaks corrupt all downstream narrative and compression stages. ByteTrack with OSNet embeddings fixes this without training.

priority_3.title: Lightweight Temporal Video Action Classifier (X3D-XS or MoViNet-A2)
priority_3.rationale: Kinematic heuristic cannot distinguish falling/picking-up/running-vs-walking. X3D-XS (4 MB, 5ms/clip) covers all Kinetics-400 activities TCE needs. Ensemble with kinematic classifier for safety.
